# writable book, main hand
T 4

STAT Alice minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_death 4
STAT Alice minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_rest 4
STAT Alice minecraft.custom:minecraft.total_world_time 4
STAT Alice minecraft.used:minecraft.writable_book 1
PKT Alice minecraft:container_set_slot 140002002401db0a0100380205666972737400067365636f6e6400

# written book
T 6
I Bob 0 minecraft:written_book*1{minecraft:written_book_content:{author:"Bob",pages:[{raw:"plain page"}],resolved:1b,title:{raw:"Title"}}}
STAT Bob minecraft.custom:minecraft.play_time 6
STAT Bob minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_death 6
STAT Bob minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_rest 6
STAT Bob minecraft.custom:minecraft.total_world_time 6
STAT Bob minecraft.used:minecraft.written_book 1
PKT Bob minecraft:container_set_slot 140002002401dc0a010039055469746c650003426f62000108000a706c61696e20706167650001
PKT Bob minecraft:open_book 3b00
# a written book with a selector is resolved against the reader when it is opened
T 7
I Bob 0 minecraft:written_book*1{minecraft:written_book_content:{author:"Bob",pages:[{raw:{selector:"@s"}},{raw:"two"}],resolved:1b,title:{raw:"Sel"}}}
STAT Bob minecraft.custom:minecraft.play_time 7
STAT Bob minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_death 7
STAT Bob minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_rest 7
STAT Bob minecraft.custom:minecraft.total_world_time 7
STAT Bob minecraft.used:minecraft.written_book 2
PKT Bob minecraft:container_set_slot 140003002401dc0a0100390353656c0003426f6200020a08000873656c6563746f7200024073000008000374776f0001
PKT Bob minecraft:open_book 3b00
